name: codeforge
description: CodeForge — Monaco code editor as web app + Android APK (Capacitor)

scripts.android: npm run setup && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('android')){require('child_process').execSync('npx cap add android',{stdio:'inherit'})}" && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync: npm run setup && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run android && cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleDebug
